_meta.description: Per-row OLS fitted values and residuals on customers.pulse with target=income and predictors=[age] via ATTR_REG_FITTED + ATTR_REG_RESIDUAL. The regression attributes are siblings: REG_FITTED emits hat(y_i) = X_i . beta + beta_0 per row; REG_RESIDUAL emits (y_i - hat(y_i)). Together they let downstream slots reason about per-row model quality without re-fitting (e.g. surfacing residual outliers via ATTR_ZSCORE on the residual column).
_meta.name: attr_reg_fitted_residual
